source_observations.fact: Auto calls getRawStatistics on the current processor. Area ROI is applied; absent or non-area ROI resets to the whole processor plane. The statistics call supplies null intensity calibration and excludes LIMIT, so display LUTs, calibrated value labels and current threshold do not filter its raw samples. Spatial calibration does not weight histogram counts.

Use 256 bins. Let N be raw statistics pixelCount, limit=floor(N/10), and divisor be5000 when previous divisor<10, otherwise floor(previous/2). Threshold=floor(N/divisor). A bin with count>limit is treated as0; a boundary bin qualifies only when the remaining count>threshold. Scan low from0 and high from255. Candidate range is histMin+[hmin,hmax]*binSize. Equal candidates use stats.min/max; hmax<hmin invokes Reset and returns. This is a per-bin rule, not cumulative percentile clipping.

U8 raw histogram is256 exact unsigned integer bins with histMin0/binSize1. U16 raw statistics first obtains unsigned integer occupancy, then normally spans observed ROI min..max using binSize=(max-min+1)/256 and truncating positive scaled indices; upper indices clamp to255. F32 normally spans observed ROI finite min..max with binSize=(max-min)/256, includes both endpoints and clamps the final bin. F32 comparisons exclude NaN and infinities under default finite thresholds. Constant and no-finite source paths need actual observations before native adoption. These are not manual threshold's fixed full-U16256-bin semantics.

Repeated state is the ContrastAdjuster instance autoThreshold. Reset and setupNewImage set it0. setupNewImage is selected by changed image ID/type/linear currentSlice; public update or image-window activation can force it by clearing previousImageID. ROI-only changes and numeric/LUT edits are not an explicit autoThreshold assignment in these methods. Do not infer precise user-event resets from source alone; observe setup invocations, previous fields and actual divisor before/after. Closing/reopening a tool creates a new cycle.

ContrastAdjuster computes double candidate bounds. Composite LUTs retain passed raw doubles while integer range getters round; U16 processors round endpoints, F32 processor endpoints narrow to binary32. Capture candidate fields, stored LUT bounds, processor bounds and reported range independently. Native requested double ranges and existing renderer endpoint policies must not be conflated with displayed labels.

Normal Auto adjusts current C at current T/Z. Shift or Color Balance All requests updateAllChannelsAndDraw. In Composite mode the sync path copies the active computed processor min/max to every C; it does not independently histogram each channel. Color/Gray mode uses active-channel redraw. Full mode/projection timing and rounded bounds require hosted observations.

Unsigned16 process range settings can affect histogram plotting and fallback Reset; they do not replace Auto's getRawStatistics call. Ordinary ImagePlus Reset distinguishes signed16 calibration; Composite Reset with nonzero default16 range can set every C to0..2^bits-1. Auto's accumulation is raw even when labels/Set use intensity calibration. Raw/signed storage, intensity mapping and spatial calibration are separate. The existing native live-XY Reset is an owned different policy and cannot silently stand in for every upstream fallback.

Successful GUI Auto records run Enhance Contrast saturated=0.35 (or the equivalent script call), not its actual divisor/range. Enhance Contrast accumulates tail counts with threshold=floor(N*0.35/200); U16 can use histogram16 for full raw resolution. Its normalize/equalize/stack options and destructive behavior are distinct. Native normalized Auto replay must apply its recorded resolved effect, never dispatch the recorded ImageJ text as if algorithmically identical.

Source adjustment refuses a calibration-bar overlay and has separate RGB snapshot/mask mutation paths. First native consumer is scalar U8/U16/F32. Preserve existing native display publication: every successful executed action advances Display once and records once iff recording is enabled, including equal logical state; no pixel/metadata/selection revision, data identity, dirty or undo/redo change.
